Past analyses of AAPL (most recent first):

[2026-09-16 | AAPL | Overweight | +1.4% | -0.7% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Overweight

**Executive Summary**: Overweight AAPL: hold the existing core untouched and build a cumulative add of roughly 30–40% of a standard allocation above the neutral baseline, in tranches and only on triggers. Initiate Tranche 1 (~10–14% of a standard allocation) only inside the 326.5–323.3 pullback band with a hard stop at 314.5 rather than the trader's 317.70, because from a 325 entry that level is ~1 ATR (7.35) and would be taken out by ordinary noise. Reserve the remaining ~60% of the add for a daily close above 336.3 on >41.9M shares, split half on the close and half on a retest that holds 333–334, sized smaller because that payoff is thin (≈−1.7% to 330.70 vs ≈+1.1% to 340.08). A daily close below 319.3 (50 SMA) pauses all adds and forces reassessment rather than averaging down, and a ~10-session no-fill fallback (half of Tranche 1 at market if price holds above the 10 EMA at 326.66) prevents the non-fill error logged on 08-19, 08-26 and 09-09.

**Investment Thesis**: DIRECTION BELONGS TO THE BULL; THE ENTRY BELONGS TO THE BEAR — SO OVERWEIGHT, STAGED, NOT BUY AT MARKET AND NOT HOLD.

The aggressive seat won the two things that change a rating. Trend: close 332.41 above the 10 EMA 326.66 > 50 SMA 319.27 > 200 SMA 285.79, the 50 SMA turned up off 309.08 (8/17), the 200 SMA rising 274.58 → 285.79 straight through the July–August selloff, MACD 4.6309 over its 3.0924 signal with both the 8/26 signal cross and 8/31 zero cross banked, RSI 62.10 constructive without being stretched, price 2.81% above VWMA 323.32, and the 7/31 gap effectively repaired (332.41 vs the 333.43 pre-gap close). Fundamentals: nine-month FCF $110.197B (+52.5%) at a 30.24% margin, gross margin +357 bp to 50.06%, operating margin +264 bp, EPS +28.7%, $62.2B net cash, D/E 0.78x from 1.34x. The conservative seat conceded the franchise and never attacked either structure.

The bear's fundamental points are legitimate haircuts, not reversals. Roughly $10.8B (~31%) of the CFO improvement was a cash-tax benefit and capex fell 28.2% (capex/D&A 0.68x) — but tax-normalized CFO was still ~$106.2B, up ~30%, more than any prior full year in the dataset. Opex +22.9% vs revenue +16.4% and FQ3 operating margin 32.63% (139 bp below the 6M average) are the weakest bear leg, because the QoQ dip lands inside a pre-production ramp and the inventory composition proves it: raw materials +260% to $7.645B while finished goods fell 4.1% to $3.447B. Parts cannot be channel-stuffed, and neither the conservative nor the neutral seat rebutted that composition read.

The conservative seat's one genuinely decisive point is the stop, and the neutral seat's arithmetic is the sharpest work in the round: at a 325 entry a 317.70 stop is ~7.3 points against an ATR of 7.3538 (2.21%) — almost exactly one ATR, not two. The aggressive seat's 1.5-to-2.7-to-1 asymmetry at 325 rests on that fragile stop and was never repaired. I fix it by widening the stop to 314.5 and cutting Tranche 1 to ~10–14% of a standard allocation (~0.35–0.45% of portfolio equity at ~3.2% risk). Its second correct point is gap risk: −7.35% on 132.5M shares on 2026-07-31 would take 332.41 to ~308, through any stop — so risk is controlled by tranche size and spacing, not by the stop. Its third is that no portfolio context was supplied, so all sizing is a fraction of the caller's own standard AAPL weight.

The conservative seat nevertheless loses the rating on its own evidence. It produced no valuation metric at all — no forward multiple, no consensus estimate, no earnings revisions — so "priced for perfection" is an assertion, not a measurement, and it cannot price the risk it invokes. Its negative catalysts are soft and unquantified: one post-close, unattributed "lukewarm" preorder headline with no units, channel data or baseline; a Siri rollout that same-day coverage says "narrows the gap"; an India probe with no fine, scope or timeline; a 5% 10-year against a $62.2B net-cash balance sheet. Its "Hold, no add, 5–10%" is a veto, and this desk's own record shows what vetoing an intact AAPL uptrend costs: 07-13, 07-20–07-24, 08-11–08-13, 08-17, 08-21, 08-24, 08-27, 08-28 and the 2026-09-08 Underweight (+5.9% five-day alpha for the stock against the trim), versus +3.8% and +6.5% alpha on the 08-26 and 09-09 Overweights.

The neutral construction is what I adopt, with the conservative arithmetic bolted on: keep the constructive bias, shrink Tranche 1, require stabilization in the 323.3–326.5 band (a close back above 326.5 after a test) instead of a blind limit into falling momentum, widen the stop, tier the breakout tranche smaller, and reserve the bulk of the capital for the 9/18 first-weekend sell-through and the late-October FQ4. Prior lessons are applied directly: the 09-09 reflection's "adds written as price gates below a rising tape never fill" is why the plan now carries a ~10-session market fallback at half size, and the 09-08 reflection's "require a confirmed trigger before cutting core exposure in an intact uptrend" is why nothing here trims the core.

EXCLUDED: the uncorroborated "New CEO" item — no tool result confirms it and it drives nothing. STATED GAPS: no valuation multiples, forward EPS or peer comparison (so every level here is technical, not valuation-derived); no segment/product/geographic mix, so the 50.06% gross-margin durability is genuinely unverified and a 300 bp reversion would be a 5–8% EPS event; no options chain or implied-vol data, so the October window cannot be hedged or priced here; no footnote on the ~$13.3B intangible additions or the ~$13.5B rise in other noncurrent liabilities; and no knowledge of the caller's holdings or cash.

WHAT WOULD CHANGE IT: a daily close below 319.3 pauses adds and forces reassessment of the entire entry structure; FQ4 gross margin below 48% with decelerating revenue, an inventory write-down, or a normalized tax rate worse than the 219 bp step-up already embedded cuts the unfilled tranches and downgrades; disappointing 9/18 iPhone 18 Pro sell-through does the same; if valuation data arrives showing 50.06% gross margin is a one-off mix/tariff artifact rather than a structural step-up, cut the remaining tranches. Upgrade toward Buy only on a volume-confirmed break of 336.3 holding the 333–334 retest, or an FQ4 confirming gross margin ≥49.5%, converting inventory, buyback re-acceleration against the 12% decline, and reconciliation of the intangible/liability swing.

**Price Target**: 340.08

**Time Horizon**: 1-3 months, re-underwritten at the 9/18 iPhone 18 Pro sell-through and the late-October FQ4 FY2026 print

REFLECTION:
The +1.4% raw return validates the bullish direction, but the -0.7% alpha means Overweight trailed the benchmark, and five days is far too short to test a 1–3 month thesis gated on 9/18 sell-through and the late-October FQ4. What the window does support is the trend read — price ended near 337, never approaching the 319.3 (50 SMA) invalidation — while the entry structure is what failed: a week that closed above the 336.3 breakout trigger almost certainly left the 326.5–323.3 Tranche 1 band unfilled, so the plan earned no exposure to its own correct call. Lesson: on a rising tape, make the market fallback at the 10 EMA the primary entry at full Tranche 1 size and treat the pullback band as a bonus fill, because gating adds below price has now cost this desk on 08-19, 08-26, 09-09 and again here.

[2026-09-15 | AAPL | Underweight | +2.5% | +0.2% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Underweight

**Executive Summary**: Underweight AAPL at $331.34 — trim 30–40% of a full-weight position down to ~60–70% of a standard AAPL allocation, worked into strength in the $333.43–$336.22 band rather than at market; if price stalls below $333, complete at least a 20–25% cut immediately. Keep a real core (the 200-SMA at $285.51 is rising with price 16% above it and $62.2B of net cash), and finish the ladder on the residual: −10–15% on a daily close below $325.38 (10-EMA), again below $322.15 (VWMA), and cut to a small residual below $318.84 with a negative MACD histogram (references $309.90, then $303.29). $336.50 is thesis invalidation, not protection: a daily close above $336.22 on ≥50M shares triggers a staged rebuild toward neutral, not toward overweight, and no adds go in ahead of the October 1 Apple–OpenAI hearing or the late-October FQ4 print.

**Investment Thesis**: The direction is not genuinely contested. All three risk seats and the trader converge on trim-plus-core, and the dispute is only about how far to go — which is why the answer is Underweight and not Sell. The conservative analyst conceded the overhead supply at $333.43–$336.22, the two rejections ($333.08 on 09-14 after tagging $335.50; $331.34 on 09-15) and the volume fade from 50.7M on 09-11 to 39.3M then 31.7M against a ~42M average; the aggressive analyst conceded the franchise; the neutral analyst conceded both and built the ladder that survives scrutiny.

What decides it is location and payoff geometry, not the business. AAPL at $331.34 is ~36x annualized 9M EPS with a ~3.0% FCF yield, pressed into the origin of a −7.37% gap printed on 132.5M shares — recovering into a high-volume breakdown is where supply lives. Decisively, the bull's own confirmation gate did print and did not resolve upward: 09-11 traded 50.7M shares and failed to hold. On the marginal share, upside to $336.22 is ~1.5% against ~3.8% to the $318.84/$319.27 mid-band and ~6.5% to $309.90 — a 2.5-to-4x penalty that both the aggressive and conservative analysts computed independently.

Earnings quality is the second leg and went unanswered. FCF growth was flattered by a ~$13.4B receivables release with DSO collapsing ~39 to ~26 days; the record 50.06% gross margin is being capitalized at peak-cycle multiples where a 300bp reversion is a 5–8% EPS event; the tax rate is already +219bp with further drift flagged; R&D is +32.5% with no disclosed payoff; the $12.7B intangible against a $13.5B liability increase is the largest unexplained balance-sheet movement of the period and implies future amortization; and the buyback pace has fallen to 79% of FCF from 121%, fading the mechanical EPS tailwind. Inventory +94% with raw materials +260% is either ramp pre-build or a write-down candidate — the aggressive read is fair but unproven on either side. The freshest demand proxy, shorter iPhone 18 Pro delivery times, is two-sided without unit data, but the bears have the cleaner read, and the Siri overhaul explicitly not requiring a new iPhone undercuts the AI replacement cycle that sustains a 36x multiple.

On the seats: the aggressive analyst wins on the supply band and on the point that "wait for confirmation" is itself a position, but loses decisively on the rebuild — sizing beyond the 0.5% tranche cap and going overweight on a one-day breakout with a 7.55-point ATR and two dated binaries ahead is not defined risk, and the $371.9 range projection is speculation rather than a level. The conservative analyst wins on gap realism and on capping the rebuild at neutral, but overreaches in implying the trim licenses indefinite defensiveness; refusing any restoration after a valid invalidation is a hidden bearish bet. The neutral construction carries: trim into strength, lean to retaining ~70% of standard unless price stalls below $333, keep the 325.38/322.15/318.84 ladder, rebuild only toward neutral and in stages on the ≥50M-share close above $336.22, and cap pullback re-adds at 0.5% of portfolio per tranche (~1–1.5% total) with a stop under $315.30.

The prior-lesson record is faced head-on, not ignored. This desk has repeatedly lost alpha underweighting AAPL inside an intact uptrend: +2.7% (08-17), +2.9% (08-21), +4.3% (08-27), +1.5% (09-02), +5.9% (09-08), −3.9% (08-13), −3.2% to −3.8% (07-20–07-24), while the 09-04 Overweight earned +5.3% and the 09-03 Hold +2.4%. The 09-08 reflection's instruction — require a confirmed trigger before cutting core, and express caution in residual size rather than pre-event de-risking — is honored three ways: the trim is executed into rejected supply at the top of the valuation band rather than at triple-tested support on momentum decay alone; the rebuild gate at $336.22 is only ~1.5% above spot, so participation is realistically reachable instead of gated behind a confluence that never prints; and a real 60–70% core is retained rather than the drift toward minimal exposure the conservative seat implied. The 09-02 lesson is also honored: sell into strength rather than at market, and cap the first cut instead of front-running the entire ladder.

What would change it. Upgrade toward Hold/Overweight on a daily close above $336.22 on ≥50M shares that holds a retest above $333.43, plus an FQ4 gross-margin guide ≥49% with clean inventory conversion and the $12.7B intangible reconciled; second stage on a close above $342.89 or two to three sessions holding. Downgrade toward Sell on a close below $303.29 with a negative MACD histogram, an FQ4 gross-margin guide below 48%, an inventory write-down, or an Apple–OpenAI ruling carrying a quantified liability.

Gaps I could not resolve and will not manufacture: no 10-Q note on the $12.7B intangible or the $13.5B liability; no unit sell-through data behind the delivery-time signal (BofA and Jefferies disagree on supply versus demand); no segment, geographic or ASP disclosure, so 50.06% margin durability is unattributable; no FQ4 guidance, leaving peak-margin and pull-forward hypotheses untestable; no options chain or implied-vol data, so no hedge can be priced and protection must come from reduced gross exposure; and no portfolio context, so all sizing is a fraction of the caller's own standard AAPL allocation subject to their single-name limits. All cited levels are technical, not valuation-derived.

**Price Target**: 319.0

**Time Horizon**: 1-3 months, re-underwritten at the October 1 Apple–OpenAI hearing and the late-October FQ4 FY2026 print

REFLECTION:
The 5-day alpha of +0.2% (raw +2.5%) means the Underweight cost essentially nothing in relative terms, but that is a 5-day window against a 1–3 month thesis and is far too short to judge the call — the price path alone, however, is unflattering. It undercuts the core location argument: AAPL rose from $331.34 to roughly $339, clearing the $336.22 invalidation/rebuild gate rather than failing at the $333.43–$336.22 supply band, so the "recovering into a high-volume breakdown" premise was not validated in this window even though the trim-into-strength execution instruction (sell in the $333–$336 band, not at market) was the correct tactic. The lesson: the ladder's rebuild gate sat only ~1.5% above spot, so an Underweight with invalidation that close is really a tactical trim with a high probability of being stopped back to neutral — next time size the underweight to survive that gate being hit, or state explicitly that the position is expected to revert to neutral within days.

[2026-09-14 | AAPL | Overweight | +1.8% | -0.1% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Overweight

**Executive Summary**: Overweight AAPL, staged and constructive rather than a chase. Tranche 1 is smaller than the trader proposed: ~20–25% of the intended overweight at market ≈ $333.08 (roughly 1.03–1.04x standard weight), because %B ≈ 0.97 into the $334.02 band offers only ~0.94% to $336.22 against 5.33% to the $315.34 stop. Tranche 2 (~35–40%) releases on a daily close above $336.22 (half credit 40–50M shares, full above 50M) or a pullback into the $318–$324 confluence (50 SMA 318.46 / Bollinger mid 317.98 / 10 EMA 324.05), whichever prints first; tranche 3 (~30%) waits for Q4 FY2026 gross margin near 50% on double-digit revenue growth. Cap total notional so a 10% adverse gap costs ≤1.0–1.2% of portfolio value (≈10–12% of portfolio value at most), reaching full 1.15x standard only after the cheaper tranches fill. A close below $324.05 pauses all adds; a close below $318–$321 on above-average volume, or below $315.34, cuts tactical tranches back to benchmark 1.0x; trim tactical layers only at $340.08 then $344.57. **Investment Thesis**: Direction is settled by the earnings engine and the trend stack; only entry geometry and size are contested — hence Overweight, not Buy and not Hold.

The aggressive analyst wins the fundamental and structural debate largely unopposed. Q3 FY2026 revenue +16.4% to $109.4B, gross margin 50.06% versus 46.49% (+357 bps), incremental gross margin 71.9%, operating income +26.6%, diluted EPS +28.7%, with the FY2026 sequence improving every quarter (+18.3% → +21.8% → +28.7%).
